content_zh:
程泽决定好好夸一夸这位新生, 结果在几个黑色的脑袋中间转了一圈, 没分清谁是谁, 问道：“哪位是连胜小可爱？”
赵卓荦拍了拍连胜的背：“最矮的这个。”
连胜郑重看向赵卓荦。两指推着他的枪口, 送到了自己的额前。
赵卓荦不解地看着她。
连胜说：“送你一分, 快开枪。”
赵卓荦懵道：“你想干嘛？”
连胜：“我想尿尿。”
赵卓荦：“……”
“快, 我憋不住了。”连胜把存着的子弹和枪支都推给他，“再会！”
众人：“……”
连胜差不多是早上八点过来的，现在已经将近二十点。也就是说, 她有将近十二个小时没有上过厕所。
早上特意没有喝水，下午四点多的时候才吃了一块干面包。预想到之后激烈的战况，她的膀胱现在非常不舒服。
程泽目瞪口呆。
他们队伍里, 原本可以有两位出类拔萃的狙击手。一个被另外一位干掉了, 另外一位被自己的生理需求干掉了。这个认知简直能让他们当场哭出声来。
都算什么事儿啊？
“你知道……”程泽嘴角苦涩道，“这已经不是裤子脱了的问题, 这是临门……蛋疼。”
连胜：“不然怎么？”
程泽：“就地？”
他们都是在野地里直接解决的, 历年如此。毕竟嘛, 都是男人, 谁没那个二两肉。关键时刻, 怎么能为了几十毫升的液体排放停止男人的征途？
但是你要求一个女生也这样你就……

连胜：“我保持沉默。”
赵卓荦：“禽兽。”
队友甲乙丙：“禽兽！”
程泽：“……”
如今山上都装了监控, 看监控的都是男教官，还不止一个。
有点丧病了。
这也的确是他们没想周到，他们没想到一个女生能坚持这么久。
连胜用她最后的耐力问道：“你们人还是太少了, 我可以下去给你们多叫几个外援。搅搅浑水也是可以的。”
手气不好, 抽到后排号码的学生，在出场之前，或许队友已经被送回来了。而季方晓的阵营，应当是有筛选要求的。在人数已经足够的情况下，不会继续扩张，毕竟这还是一场以淘汰为主要目的的活动，不是为了促进人民大和谐。
这就意味着，后期落单的学生，只能走个过场。要么躲到活动结束，要么主动上前送一滴血。根本体会不到活动的快感，也积攒不了什么经验。
实力差距产生后的阶级压迫。
人多一点过来帮忙，感情是好的，如果外援可靠的话。
赵卓荦说：“可以是可以，就是怕内应。”到时候他们位置暴露，被上面的人反包围就不妙了。
“放心。我在后方坐镇。”连胜挪了挪屁股，“你们到时候见机行事，抢杀人头。”
输可以，但不能打的不痛快。像现在这样就非常不痛快。
而这场个人赛，从本质上来说，并没有所谓的输赢。活到最后的不一定分数高，提前退场的也不一定分数低。
个人战的归宿，应该是大混战！
连胜因为尿急，要提前告别这个战场。几人含泪看着她。
曾经有人提过这个建议但是被他们无情的嘲笑的，事到如今终于孽力反噬自食恶果。
这赛场设置有缺陷！他们要求加厕所！

连胜大义凛然道：“开枪吧。”
赵卓荦举起了枪。
“诶等等！”连胜忽然叫停，扭头朝前面看去。那边有一道强光，正从上路下来。
应该是教官过来认领刚才激战中牺牲的同志。
连胜矫捷的蹦起，然后朝着外面冲去。
“教官！”连胜抬手喊道，“教官留步！”
他们的对讲机，是单向设置的。毕竟没有教官愿意听他们叨叨。但是，他们有机会看见真人。
那教官抬起了手，做了个示意，问道：“怎么了？”
连胜说：“我要上厕所！”
教官：“……”
那教官有些茫然。活动举办多年，都没这种规矩。但听她声音是个女的，让她憋着，实在是太不人道了。让她就地……
“给她上！”
付教官的声音从对讲机里传来，他激动道：“不带这么欺负人的啊。我怎么说的？女兵太少了，能打的女兵就更少了，不要用这样的方式去考验人家，根本没有意义！”
旁边一人崩溃道：“我说你怎么又来了？你就闲的这么蛋疼啊？”
付教官喊：“快快快！我马上过来安排！”

Cheng Ze decided to praise the new student, but he turned around among several black heads, unable to tell who was who, and asked: "Which one is the cutie with a winning streak?"
Zhao Zhuorun patted Lian Sheng's back: "The shortest one."
Lian Sheng looked at Zhao Zhuorun solemnly. Two fingers pushed the muzzle of his gun to his forehead.
Zhao Zhuorun looked at her puzzled.
Lian Sheng said: "I'll give you one point, shoot quickly."
Zhao Zhuorun said in confusion: "What do you want to do?"
Streak: “I need to pee.”
Zhao Zhuorun: "..."
"Come on, I can't hold it in anymore." Lian Sheng pushed all the bullets and guns he had saved to him, "Goodbye!"
Everyone: "..."
Streak came here at about eight o'clock in the morning, and now it's almost twenty o'clock. In other words, she had not been to the toilet for nearly twelve hours.
I purposely didn't drink water in the morning, and only ate a piece of dry bread around four in the afternoon. Anticipating the fierce battle that followed, her bladder was now very uncomfortable.
Cheng Ze was stunned.
There could have been two outstanding snipers in their team. One was killed by the other, and the other was killed by his own physiological needs. This realization can make them cry on the spot.
What does it all mean?
"You know..." Cheng Ze said bitterly, "This is no longer a matter of taking off your pants, this is a matter of pain..."
Streak: "What else?"
Cheng Ze: "On the spot?"
They were all solved directly in the wild, and this has been the case for many years. After all, we are all men, and no one has that little bit of flesh. At the critical moment, how can a man's journey be stopped for the discharge of dozens of milliliters of liquid?
But if you ask a girl to do the same thing, then...
Streak: "I remain silent."
Zhao Zhuorun: "Beast."
Teammates A, B and C: "Beasts!"
Cheng Ze: "..."
Nowadays, surveillance cameras are installed on the mountain, and the people watching the surveillance cameras are all male instructors, and there is more than one.
Feeling a little sick.
This is indeed because they were not thoughtful. They did not expect that a girl could persist for such a long time.
Lian Sheng used her last stamina to ask: "There are still too few of you. I can go down and call you some more foreign aid. It's okay to stir up the muddy water."
Students who are unlucky and get the numbers in the back row may have their teammates sent back before playing. Ji Fangxiao's camp should have screening requirements. When the number of people is already sufficient, it will not continue to expand. After all, this is still an event whose main purpose is elimination, not to promote the great harmony of the people.
This means that students who are left alone later can only go through the motions. Either hide until the event is over, or take the initiative to give a drop of blood. I can't feel the pleasure of activities at all, and I can't accumulate any experience.
Class oppression after the power gap arises.
If more people come to help, the relationship will be better, if the foreign aid is reliable.
Zhao Zhuorun said: "It's okay, but I'm afraid of internal reaction." When their position is exposed, it will be bad if they are surrounded by people from above.
"Don't worry. I'll be at the back." Lian Sheng moved his buttocks and said, "You will act accordingly when the time comes and snatch the heads."
It's okay to lose, but you can't play unpleasantly. It's very unpleasant to be like this now.
In this individual competition, essentially, there is no so-called winning or losing. Those who survive to the end may not necessarily have a high score, and those who leave early may not necessarily have a low score.
The destination of individual battles should be a big melee!
Because of the urgency of urination, Lian Sheng had to bid farewell to this battlefield in advance. Several people looked at her with tears in their eyes.
Someone once made this suggestion but was ridiculed mercilessly by them, and now they are finally reaping the consequences.
This arena setup is flawed! They asked for a toilet!
Liansheng Dayi said solemnly: "Just shoot."
Zhao Zhuorun raised his gun.
"Hey, wait!" Lian Sheng suddenly stopped and turned to look ahead. thereThere was a bright light coming down the road.
It should be the instructor who came to claim the comrade who died in the fierce battle just now.
Lian Sheng jumped up quickly and then rushed outside.
"Instructor!" Lian Sheng raised his hand and shouted, "Instructor, stay!"
Their walkie-talkies are set up to be one-way. After all, no instructor wants to listen to them. However, they had a chance to see real people.
The instructor raised his hand, gestured, and asked, "What's wrong?"
Lian Sheng said: "I need to go to the toilet!"
Instructor: "..."
The instructor was a little confused. The event has been held for many years without such rules. But her voice was that of a woman, and it was really inhumane to let her hold it in. Leave her where she is...
"Fuck her!"
Instructor Fu's voice came from the walkie-talkie, and he said excitedly: "There are no bullies like this. What did I say? There are too few female soldiers, and there are even fewer female soldiers who can fight. Don't use this method to test others, there is no point at all!"
Someone next to me collapsed and said, "Why are you here again? Are you so idle?"
Instructor Fu shouted: "Hurry, hurry, hurry! I'll come over right away to make arrangements!"
